title: Pretrained MRI classifier transfers to a Chinese Alzheimer's cohort without retraining
summary: A classifier pretrained on Western samples was applied without retraining to the independent SILCODE cohort (722 participants, 1105 scans). It classified Alzheimer's disease with AUC 0.913 and sensitivity 95.2%, and flagged 90.5% of high-risk individuals 2-3 years before clinical diagnosis. Risk scores correlated with cognitive measures and plasma biomarkers, especially p-tau 217, and brain risk maps suggested subtypes including a rapid-decline subgroup.
